What to enter Enter the maximum number of screen-time hours allowed per day. Available for FieldX EMM Where to find it Restrictions / Device Usage Limits / Total Screen Time for the day (in Hours) When should I use this? Use this to enforce an overall daily usage cap rather than limiting individual apps. Important notes Note: Screen time is tracked from 4:00 AM to 3:59 AM the following day.

title: Ambient Display
text: Ambient Display What it does Controls whether Ambient Display mode is available to the user. Enabling this restriction disables automatic brightness changes tied to Ambient Display. Option What it does Allow Allows the behavior controlled by this restriction. Disallow Prevents the behavior controlled by this restriction. Available for FieldX EMM Where to find it Restrictions / Display & Brightness / Ambient Display When should I use this? Use this to standardize display behavior across a device fleet.

title: Config Brightness
text: Config Brightness What it does Controls whether the user can adjust screen brightness. Option What it does Allow Allows the behavior controlled by this restriction. Disallow Prevents the behavior controlled by this restriction. Available for FieldX EMM Where to find it Restrictions / Display & Brightness / Config Brightness When should I use this? Use this to lock brightness to a fixed level for consistency or battery-life reasons.

title: Config Screen Timeout
text: Config Screen Timeout What it does Controls whether the user can change the screen-off timeout. Option What it does Allow Allows the behavior controlled by this restriction. Disallow Prevents the behavior controlled by this restriction. Available for FieldX EMM Minimum Android API level Pie 9.0 (28) Where to find it Restrictions / Display & Brightness / Config Screen Timeout When should I use this? Use this to enforce a consistent screen-timeout policy across devices.

title: Geofencing Boundaries
text: Geofencing Boundaries What it does Defines the geographic boundary within which the device is allowed to operate. If the device leaves the boundary, it is automatically locked. Configured through its own settings window in the FieldX console rather than a simple Allow/Disallow toggle. Available for Not specified in the FieldX source. Where to find it Restrictions / Geofencing / Geofencing Boundaries When should I use this? Use this for high-value or regulated devices that must never leave a specific site or region.

title: Kiosk Mode Settings
text: Kiosk Mode Settings What it does Configures Kiosk Mode: which apps are permitted, and which Settings icons (if any) remain visible to the user. What to enter Use the Kiosk configuration window in FieldX. Package names must be valid apps already installed on the device or pushed from the platform. Available for FieldX EMM, Android Enterprise Where to find it Restrictions / Kiosk Policies / Kiosk Mode Settings When should I use this? Use this to lock a device into a single-purpose, restricted-app kiosk experience.

title: Kiosk Admin Password
text: Kiosk Admin Password What it does Sets the password required to exit Kiosk Mode, provided as an MD5 hash. What to enter Enter an MD5 hash of the password (case-sensitive, no length restriction). Hashes can be generated at md5hashgenerator.com. Available for FieldX EMM, Android Enterprise Where to find it Restrictions / Kiosk Policies / Kiosk Admin Password When should I use this? Use this to make sure only authorized staff can exit Kiosk Mode.

title: Kiosk Browse Url
text: Kiosk Browse Url What it does Restricts the device to displaying a single URL. Exiting the browser requires entering a PIN. What to enter Enter the URL to lock the device to. Available for FieldX EMM, Android Enterprise Where to find it Restrictions / Kiosk Policies / Kiosk Browse Url When should I use this? Use this for single-purpose web kiosks, such as a check-in screen or a public information display.

title: Location State
text: Location State What it does Forces the device's location setting to a fixed state, overriding user control. Option What it does Always ON Location services are forced on at all times. Always OFF Location services are forced off at all times. Available for FieldX EMM, Android Enterprise Where to find it Restrictions / Location Services / Location State When should I use this? Use Always ON for field-tracking or delivery use cases; use Always OFF where location tracking must be prevented.

title: Location Toggle
text: Location Toggle What it does Controls whether the user can enable or disable individual location providers. Option What it does Allow Allows the behavior controlled by this restriction. Disallow Prevents the behavior controlled by this restriction. Available for FieldX EMM Where to find it Restrictions / Location Services / Allow Location Configuration When should I use this? Use this when location should stay user-configurable but changes should be blocked entirely.

title: Location Sharing
text: Location Sharing What it does Controls whether the user can turn on location sharing. Option What it does Allow Allows the behavior controlled by this restriction. Disallow Prevents the behavior controlled by this restriction. Available for FieldX EMM Minimum Android API level Jelly Bean 4.3 (18) Where to find it Restrictions / Location Services / Allow Location Sharing When should I use this? Use this to prevent a user from sharing their location with apps or contacts outside of organizational policy.

title: User Switch
text: User Switch What it does Controls whether switching to a different user is blocked from the current user. Option What it does Allow Allows the behavior controlled by this restriction. Disallow Prevents the behavior controlled by this restriction. Available for FieldX EMM Where to find it Restrictions / Multi-User & Account Management / User Switch When should I use this? Use this on shared or single-assignee devices where other user profiles should not be reachable.

title: Allow add Managed Profile
text: Allow add Managed Profile What it does Controls whether the user can add a managed (work) profile to the device. Option What it does Allow Allows the behavior controlled by this restriction. Disallow Prevents the behavior controlled by this restriction. Available for FieldX EMM Where to find it Restrictions / Multi-User & Account Management / Allow add Managed Profile When should I use this? Use this to control whether users can create their own managed profile outside of MDM provisioning.

title: Add User
text: Add User What it does Controls whether the user can add new users to the device. Option What it does Allow Allows the behavior controlled by this restriction. Disallow Prevents the behavior controlled by this restriction. Available for FieldX EMM Where to find it Restrictions / Multi-User & Account Management / Add User When should I use this? Use this to prevent uncontrolled proliferation of user accounts on managed hardware.

title: Remove Managed Profile
text: Remove Managed Profile What it does Controls whether the managed profile can be removed by someone other than its profile owner. Option What it does Allow Allows the behavior controlled by this restriction. Disallow Prevents the behavior controlled by this restriction. Available for FieldX EMM, Android Enterprise Where to find it Restrictions / Multi-User & Account Management / Remove Managed Profile When should I use this? Use this to stop the managed profile (and its enrollment) from being deleted outside of MDM control.

title: Remove User
text: Remove User What it does When set on the primary user, controls whether that user can remove other users from the device. Option What it does Allow Allows the behavior controlled by this restriction. Disallow Prevents the behavior controlled by this restriction. Available for FieldX EMM Where to find it Restrictions / Multi-User & Account Management / Remove User When should I use this? Use this to prevent the primary user from deleting other user accounts on a shared device.

title: Allow Change User Icon
text: Allow Change User Icon What it does Controls whether the user is allowed to change their user icon. Option What it does Allow Allows the behavior controlled by this restriction. Disallow Prevents the behavior controlled by this restriction. Available for FieldX EMM Minimum Android API level Nougat 7.0 (24) Where to find it Restrictions / Multi-User & Account Management / Allow Change User Icon When should I use this? Use this for cosmetic lockdown on shared or kiosk devices.

title: Share Into Managed Profile
text: Share Into Managed Profile What it does Controls whether the user can share files, pictures, or data from the primary profile into the managed profile — either by sending it directly or by picking it up from within an app in the managed profile. Option What it does Allow Allows the behavior controlled by this restriction. Disallow Prevents the behavior controlled by this restriction. Available for FieldX EMM Minimum Android API level Pie 9.0 (28) Where to find it Restrictions / Multi-User & Account Management / Share Into Managed Profile When should I use this? Use this to control one-way data flow from the personal side into the work profile.

title: Modify Accounts
text: Modify Accounts What it does Controls whether the user can add or remove accounts, unless those accounts are added programmatically by an Authenticator. Option What it does Allow Allows the behavior controlled by this restriction. Disallow Prevents the behavior controlled by this restriction. Use this to stop users from adding personal accounts (email, cloud storage, etc.) to a managed device.

title: Airplane Mode

title: Add Private DNS
text: Add Private DNS What it does Sets a private DNS server for the device. If the DNS server becomes unreachable, the device may lose internet connectivity. Available for FieldX EMM Where to find it Restrictions / Network - General / Add Private DNS When should I use this? text: Enforce WiFi Status What it does Forces Wi-Fi on or off by default; the user cannot toggle it themselves. Option What it does On Turns the controlled feature on. Use this to guarantee devices always stay connected (On) or to force cellular-only operation (Off).

Use this to pre-provision known Wi-Fi networks on managed devices without user setup.

text: Hide Notifications What it does Hides notifications from selected apps. Requires the user to enable Notification Listener access for FieldX. title: Max. Failed Password Attempts
text: Max. Failed Password Attempts What it does Sets the number of failed lock-screen attempts allowed before the device is automatically wiped and its data deleted. Failed Password Attempts When should I use this? Use this to protect data on lost or stolen devices — set conservatively, since this triggers a full wipe.

Option What it does Allow Allows the behavior controlled by this restriction. Disallow Prevents the behavior controlled by this restriction. Available for FieldX EMM Where to find it Restrictions / Password & Lock Screen / Allow Lock Screen When should I use this? text: Keyguard Password Security What it does Sets the minimum lock-screen password complexity required on the device. Low Security Applies the low-security lock-screen password policy. Any Password Security Allows any of the supported password-security levels. Available for FieldX EMM Where to find it Restrictions / Password & Lock Screen / Keyguard Password Security When should I use this? Use this to enforce a minimum password strength across managed devices.

text: Keyguard Timeout What it does Sets how long a passcode can go unchanged before the user is forced to reset it. Use this to enforce periodic passcode rotation as part of a security policy.

title: Lock Screen Message
text: Lock Screen Message What it does Sets device-owner information shown on the lock screen. Available for FieldX EMM Where to find it Restrictions / Password & Lock Screen / Lock Screen Message When should I use this? Use this to display organization contact or ownership information for anyone who finds a lost device.

title: Allow Outgoing Calls
text: Allow Outgoing Calls What it does Controls whether the user can make outgoing phone calls. Incoming and emergency calls remain available regardless of this setting. Every 5 Days The device reboots every 5 days. Every 6 Days The device reboots every 6 days. title: Reboot around time
text: Reboot around time What it does Sets the approximate time of day the scheduled reboot occurs, within roughly a 30-minute window. What to enter Enter the target reboot time. Available for FieldX EMM Where to find it Restrictions / Reboot Device / Reboot around time When should I use this? Use this to schedule reboots during off-hours so they don't interrupt active use.

Where to find it Restrictions / Sound & Volume Control / Set System Volume When should I use this? Use this to standardize the starting volume level across a device fleet.
